segments.an7.64:1.1: “Sattime, bhikkhave, dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati –
segments.an7.64:1.6: Na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa vaṇṇavatāya nandati.
segments.an7.64:1.7: Kodhanoyaṃ [kodhanāyaṃ (ka.)], bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñcāpi so hoti sunhāto suvilitto kappitakesamassu odātavatthavasano [odātavasano (ka.)];
segments.an7.64:1.8: atha kho so dubbaṇṇova hoti kodhābhibhūto.
segments.an7.64:1.9: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:2.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati –
segments.an7.64:2.4: Na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa sukhaseyyāya nandati.
segments.an7.64:2.5: Kodhanoyaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñcāpi so pallaṅke seti gonakatthate paṭalikatthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhatolohitakūpadhāne;
segments.an7.64:2.6: atha kho so dukkhaññeva seti kodhābhibhūto.
segments.an7.64:2.7: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati –
segments.an7.64:3.4: Na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa pacuratthatāya nandati.
segments.an7.64:3.5: Kodhanoyaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto, anatthampi gahetvā ‘attho me gahito’ti maññati, atthampi gahetvā ‘anattho me gahito’ti maññati.
segments.an7.64:3.6: Tassime dhammā aññamaññaṃ vipaccanīkā gahitā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti kodhābhibhūtassa.
segments.an7.64:3.7: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:4.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati –
segments.an7.64:4.4: Na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa bhogavatāya nandati.
segments.an7.64:4.5: Kodhanassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodhābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, yepissa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sedāvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, tepi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodhābhibhūtassa.
segments.an7.64:4.6: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:5.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati –
segments.an7.64:5.4: Na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa yasavatāya nandati.
segments.an7.64:5.5: Kodhanoyaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto, yopissa so hoti yaso appamādādhigato, tamhāpi dhaṃsati kodhābhibhūto.
segments.an7.64:5.6: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, pañcamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:6.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati –
segments.an7.64:6.4: Na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa mittavatāya nandati.
segments.an7.64:6.5: Kodhanaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalaṃ kodhābhibhūtaṃ kodhaparetaṃ, yepissa te honti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā, tepi ārakā parivajjanti kodhābhibhūtaṃ.
segments.an7.64:6.6: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, chaṭṭho dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:7.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa evaṃ icchati –
segments.an7.64:7.2: ‘aho vatāyaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyā’ti!
segments.an7.64:7.4: Na, bhikkhave, sapatto sapattassa sugatigamane nandati.
segments.an7.64:7.5: Kodhanoyaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodhābhibhūto kodhapareto kāyena duccaritaṃ carati, vācāya duccaritaṃ carati, manasā duccaritaṃ carati.
segments.an7.64:7.6: So kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya … pe …
segments.an7.64:7.7: kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati kodhābhibhūto.
segments.an7.64:7.8: Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, sattamo dhammo sapattakanto sapattakaraṇo kodhanaṃ āgacchati itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā.
segments.an7.64:8.1: Ime kho, bhikkhave, satta dhammā sapattakantā sapattakaraṇā kodhanaṃ āgacchanti itthiṃ vā purisaṃ vā”ti.
segments.an7.64:16.1: “Nāssa hirī na ottappaṃ [na assa hirī ottappañca (ka.)],
segments.an7.64:25.2: vītalobhā anussukā [anissukā (sī. syā.) tadaṭṭhakathāsu pana “anussukā” tveva dissati];

lines: Ekādasame sapattakantāti sapattānaṃ verīnaṃ kantā piyā tehi icchitapatthitā.
Na vāco hoti gāravoti vacanassapi garubhāvo na hoti.
Na dīpaṃ hoti kiñcananti kāci patiṭṭhā nāma na hoti.
Yāya mātu bhatoti yāya mātarā bhato posito.
Hanti kuddho puthuttānanti kuddho puggalo puthu nānākāraṇehi attānaṃ hanti.
Taṃ damena samucchindeti taṃ kodhaṃ damena chindeyya.
Paññāvīriyena diṭṭhiyāti vipassanāpaññāya ceva vipassanāsampayuttena kāyikacetasikavīriyena ca maggasammādiṭṭhiyā ca.
Tatheva dhamme sikkhethāti yathā akusalaṃ samucchindeyya, samathavipassanādhammepi tatheva sikkheyya.
Mā no dummaṅkuyaṃ ahūti mā amhākaṃ dummaṅkubhāvo ahosīti imamatthaṃ patthayamānā.
Dubbaṇṇova hotīti pakatiyā vaṇṇavāpi alaṅkatappaṭiyattopi mukhavikārādivasena virūpo eva hoti.
Etarahi āyatiñcāti kodhābhibhūtassa ekantamidaṃ phalanti dīpetuṃ “dubbaṇṇovā”ti avadhāraṇaṃ katvā puna “kodhābhibhūto”ti vuttaṃ.
Taṃ jano nāvabujjhatīti kodhasaṅkhātaṃ antarato abbhantare attano citteyeva jātaṃ anatthajananacittappakopanādibhayaṃ bhayahetuṃ ayaṃ bālamahājano na jānāti.
Yasmiṃ kāle kodho sahate naraṃ, andhatamaṃ tadā hotīti sambandho.
Yanti vā kāraṇavacanaṃ, yasmā kodho uppajjamāno naraṃ sahate abhibhavati, tasmā andhatamaṃ tadā hoti, yadā kuddhoti attho yaṃ-taṃ-saddānaṃ ekantasambandhabhāvato.
Sahateti yadetaṃ kodhassa sahanaṃ abhibhavanaṃ, etaṃ andhatamaṃ bhavananti attho.
Atha vā yaṃ naraṃ kodho sahate abhibhavati, tassa andhatamaṃ tadā hoti.
Tato ca kuddho atthaṃ na jānāti, kuddho dhammaṃ na passatīti.
Bhūnaṃ vuccati vuddhi, tassa hananaṃ ghāto etesanti bhūnahaccāni.
Dama -saddena vuttamevatthaṃ vibhāvetuṃ paññāvīriyena diṭṭhiyāti vuttanti dassento “katarena damenā”tiādimāha.
“Saccena danto damasā upeto, vedantagū vusitabrahmacariyo”ti (saṃ. ni.1.195; su. ni.467) ettha hi indriyasaṃvaro damoti vutto “manacchaṭṭhāni indriyāni dametī”ti katvā.
“Yadi saccā damā cāgā, khantyā bhiyyodha vijjatī”ti (saṃ. ni.1.246; su. ni.191) ettha paññā damo “saṃkilesaṃ dameti pajahatī”ti katvā.
“Dānena damena saṃyamena saccavajjena atthi puññaṃ, atthi puññassa āgamo”ti (saṃ. ni.4.365) ettha uposathakammaṃ damo “upavasanavasena kāyakammādīni dametī”ti katvā.

“Sakkhissasi kho tvaṃ, puṇṇa, iminā damūpasamena samannāgato sunāparantasmiṃ janapadantare viharitun”ti (ma. ni.3.396; saṃ. ni.4.88) ettha adhivāsanakkhanti damo “kodhūpanāhamakkhādike dameti vinodetī”ti katvā.
“Na mānakāmassa damo idhatthi, na monamatthi asamāhitassā”ti (saṃ. ni.1.9) ettha abhisambojjhaṅgādiko samādhipakkhiko dhammo damo “dammati cittaṃ etenā”ti katvā.
Idhāpi “taṃ damena samucchinde, paññāvīriyena diṭṭhiyā”ti vacanato dama -saddena paññāvīriyadiṭṭhiyo vuttā.
